title: correlation.create
description: This method allows to create new correlations.

status.description: Whether the correlation is enabled or disabled. Possible values are: 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

evaltype.description: Filter condition evaluation method. Possible values: 0 - and/or; 1 - and; 2 - or; 3 - custom expression.

type.description: Type of condition. Possible values: 0 - old event tag; 1 - new event tag; 2 - new event host group; 3 - event tag pair; 4 - old event tag value; 5 - new event tag value.

tag.description: Event tag (old or new). Required when type of condition is: 0, 1, 4, 5.

groupid.description: Host group ID. Required when type of condition is: 2.

oldtag.description: Old event tag. Required when type of condition is: 3.

newtag.description: New event tag. Required when type of condition is: 3.

value.description: Event tag (old or new) value. Required when type of condition is: 4, 5.

formulaid.description: Arbitrary unique ID that is used to reference the condition from a custom expression. Can only contain capital-case letters. The ID must be defined by the user when modifying filter conditions, but will be generated anew when requesting them afterward.

operator.description: Condition operator. Required when type of condition is: 2, 4, 5.

conditions.description: Set of filter conditions to use for filtering results.

formula.description: User-defined expression to be used for evaluating conditions of filters with a custom expression. The expression must contain IDs that reference specific filter conditions by its formulaid. The IDs used in the expression must exactly match the ones defined in the filter conditions: no condition can remain unused or omitted. Required for custom expression filters.

filter.description: Correlation filter object for the correlation.

type.description: Type of operation. Possible values: 0 - close old events; 1 - close new event.

operations.description: Correlation operations to create for the correlation.
